notes.title: "Meow!!" Game Update - New Control Options
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38982386/ab88a3dfc9082c38ba8d516685033910035afb05.jpg[/img]

We are thrilled to announce an exciting update to the "Meow!!" game. Now you can enjoy new ways to play and experience "Meow!!" like never before!

Keyboard Control: Perfect your precision with swift movements using the keyboard. Master each level with ease and efficiency.

Joystick Support: Immerse yourself in the gaming experience by connecting a joystick. Feel fully engaged as you guide the cats on their thrilling journeys.

The choice is yours! Unlock the full potential of "Meow!!" with these new control options.

Download the update now and enjoy an enhanced gaming experience!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2363390

notes.title: Explore Historic Monuments and Solve Puzzles in Our Exciting New Game!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38982386/2d905824b0637a263a10b2cd1b512c97d01b5884.jpg[/img]

Discover historic monuments with our puzzle game! With 20 incredible images and 5 levels of difficulty, this game will challenge your mind and take you on a journey through history. Test your skills in free mode or challenge mode. Play now and start exploring the world of historic monuments!

[b]Release Date: June 22nd
[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlock and explore 20 stunning images
[*] 5 levels of difficulty for players of all skill levels
[*] Free mode to relax and appreciate the beauty of the monuments
[*] Challenge mode to test your skills and push your limits
[/list]

Don't miss out! Be ready for the release on June 22nd!

I hope this helps! Good luck with the launch of your new game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2363920/

notes.title: PuzzlePet - Feed your cat is now available
notes.content:
[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38982386/cf9caa688d958992d6fb4b6f95b31221d6cd6234.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38982386/536ac841b4377798323120b32240d1a9647a34a5.jpg[/img][/url]
PuzzlePet - Feed your cat is now available

Kittens love to play and walk everywhere until they get tired, then it's time to sleep or eat. In this game, solve puzzles by managing food and feeding the kittens scattered across the stage.




Functionalities:
- Click to move, collect and feed the kittens.
- Minimalist graphics;
- 50 levels;
- Relaxing music

Feed a cute kitten today!


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542840/PuzzlePet__Feed_your_cat/]Play Now[/url]
